rounds.text: Majestic Auto Ltd is currently trading at a deep discount to its intrinsic value, evidenced by a price-to-book ratio of 0.68x [E1] and a P/E ratio of 3.16x, which sits significantly below the sector benchmark of 15.29x [E5]. This valuation gap is further highlighted by a P/B ratio of 0.43x compared to the sector benchmark of 1.98x [E6], suggesting the market has severely undervalued the company’s asset base. Investors are being paid to wait for a re-rating, as the stock offers a robust dividend yield of 5.85% [E3]. Despite historical sales challenges, the company demonstrates superior operational efficiency with an ROA of 13.4%, nearly double the sector benchmark of 7.58% [E7]. Recent momentum is also visible, with the stock trading at 81% of its 52-week range [E4] and positive signals including YoY profit growth exceeding 20% [E64] and QoQ sales growth [E65]. Conceded: the company faces significant headwinds, including a 10-year compounded sales growth of -17% [E13], a trailing twelve-month profit decline of -244% [E18], and an ROE of 3.55% that trails the sector benchmark of 11.99% [E8].
